dedupe_keys.name: san francisco international airport air traffic passenger statistics datasf

description: DataSF publishes San Francisco International Airport's monthly passenger traffic statistics by airline. The data are self-reported by airlines, available only at monthly level and updated quarterly; the rows were last updated on 22 September 2026. Columns give the activity period and its start date, the operating and published airline with IATA codes, a geographic summary and region, the activity type (such as enplaned or deplaned), price category, terminal, boarding area and passenger count. The description warns that airport data are seasonal, so comparisons should be made year over year for the same month, and that passenger counts for an airline appear in several attribute fields and are additive. Coverage: one airport, SFO. Format and access: the Socrata open data portal with CSV and JSON exports and an API, without registration. Licence and cost: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License, free. Caveats: airline self-reporting and additive attribute fields make totals easy to double count. It gives terminal- and airline-level demand for capacity planning models of airports. It complements the BTS T-100 statistics and the UK CAA airport statistics in the catalogue.
